rows.grounds: absolutive from spṛś; action of touching before salutation
compound adjective describing the devotee's inner state
compound describing gentle head inclination in reverence

items.question: How should the disciple approach the guru after prostration?
premises: the disciple touches the ground in reverence
the heart is purified before salutation
the head is only slightly bowed
items.inference: reverent bodily posture completes the guru salutation
uncertainties: exact object of spṛṣṭvā is not explicit in this fragment
viśuddhahṛdaya may be read as adjective or compound stem
items.plain_english: Having touched [the ground], with purified heart and slightly bowed head.
